author: SickProdigy
description: Connect each Discord server to an owner-approved or isolated guild-managed Navidrome library, manage linked users, browse recent albums, and announce new additions.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild connection mode and URL selections, announcement settings, announced album IDs, and Discord-to-Navidrome account mappings. It does not store generated user passwords. Owner and guild Navidrome administrator credentials are stored separately in isolated Red shared API token namespaces.
install_msg: Run `[p]navidromeset setup` to select an owner-approved connection. Bot owners may enable isolated guild-managed public-HTTPS connections with `[p]navidromeowner guildconnections true`. Album notifications are optional.
name: Navidrome
short: Per-server Navidrome connections, linked users, and album announcements
